description: Motor Vehicle Prohibition Regulation Routes is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by Wildlife. These lines represent routes within Motor Vehicle Prohibition Regulation Areas where motor vehicles are prohibited or restricted year round or seasonally. These lines were created as a visual representation of the Wildlife Act Motor Vehicle Prohibition Regulations. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher Wildlife. Its tags are MVPR, Routes, Wildlife Act. It offers 3 resource(s) in KML, MULTIPLE, WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - British Columbia. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
